**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

Have you ever gone into/ a high-street shop wearing/ a pair of cycling shorts?
solution:
The correct answer is **"No error**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The sentence **"Have you ever gone into a high-street shop wearing a pair of cycling shorts?"** is correct because it follows the standard structure of a question in English.
 
• It begins with the interrogative word **"Have,"** which is the auxiliary verb used to form questions in the present perfect tense.
 
• The sentence you provided is grammatically correct and free of errors.
 
• The subject** "you" **matches with the appropriate form of the verb "have."
 
• It's well-constructed and clear in its expression.
 
• The correct answer is option 1.
